message.content:
**Gini coefficient for the United States (latest available estimate)**  
- **Value:** **≈ 0.41** (or **41 %**)  
- **Year of estimate:** 2022 (most recent data published by the World Bank and corroborated by OECD)

> The Gini coefficient is a single‑number summary of income or wealth inequality, where 0 represents perfect equality and 1 represents maximal inequality. A value of 0.41 indicates a moderate level of inequality relative to many other high‑income countries.

**Sources**

| Source | Year | Gini (US) |
|--------|------|-----------|
| World Bank – World Development Indicators | 2022 | 0.41 |
| OECD – Income Distribution Database | 2022 | 0.41 |

> Note: Different agencies may publish slightly different figures (e.g., 0.40–0.42) depending on methodology and the exact definition of “income” used. The figure above reflects the most widely cited estimate for 2022.
